ADDENDUM TO OFFICE SERVICES AGREEMENT
Space Relocation

This Addendum (this "Addendum") is entered into and made effective as of June 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between:

   PROVIDER: KIWI RENTALS LLC, a Delaware limited liability company
             108 West 13th Street, Wilmington, Delaware

   CLIENT:   AnnQ Solutions LLC (signed by Hanna Chepyshko)

RECITALS

A. Provider and Client are parties to that certain Office Services Agreement dated 2026-03-13 (the "Agreement"), pursuant to which Client holds a license (and not a lease) to use Space 315 within Provider's facility located at 6698 68th Ave N, Pinellas Park, FL 33781 (the "Center"). The space currently identified in Schedule A is referred to herein as the "Original Space."

B. Section II.3 of the Agreement reserves to Provider the right to relocate Client to comparable space within the Center upon at least ten (10) days' advance notice. The parties wish to memorialize their mutual agreement to a specific relocation, on the terms set forth below.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. RELOCATION OF SPACE. Effective on the Effective Date, Client shall surrender and vacate the Original Space (Space 315) and shall take possession of Space 319 containing approximately 163 rentable square feet located within the Center (the "New Space"). Schedule A of the Agreement is hereby amended to substitute the New Space for the Original Space. From and after the Effective Date, all references in the Agreement to the "Space" shall mean the New Space.

2. BASE FEE. The monthly Base Fee shall remain unchanged at $700 per month, payable in advance on the first calendar day of each month in accordance with Section IV.1 of the Agreement.

3. SERVICE RETAINER / DEPOSIT. The Service Retainer (Deposit) currently held by Provider under Section IV.3 of the Agreement shall continue to be held by Provider and shall apply to the New Space and to Client's obligations under the Agreement, as modified by this Addendum. No additional Service Retainer shall be required by reason of this relocation.

4. CONDITION OF NEW SPACE. Client accepts the New Space in its then-current "as-is" condition. Provider makes no representation or warranty as to the condition of the New Space except as expressly set forth in the Agreement or in a separate writing signed by Provider. Client's obligations under Section VI.5 (Inventory & Condition) and Section XIV (Vacation; Restoration; Holdover) of the Agreement shall apply to the Original Space upon surrender thereof.

5. NO CHANGE IN CHARACTER OF AGREEMENT. The parties affirm that the Agreement remains a license and not a lease (Section II.1 of the Agreement), and that this relocation does not create a landlord-tenant relationship or any tenancy rights in either the Original Space or the New Space.

6. NO OTHER CHANGES. Except as expressly modified by this Addendum (including the amended Schedule A reference and, where applicable, the actual-day proration override of Section IV.1 for the cutoff month), all terms, covenants, and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect. In the event of any conflict between this Addendum and the Agreement, the terms of this Addendum shall control with respect to the subject matter hereof.

7. COUNTERPARTS; ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES. This Addendum may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Signatures delivered by electronic means (including DocuSign or PDF) shall have the same force and effect as original signatures, consistent with Section XVI.6 of the Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Addendum as of the Effective Date.

body.stringValue:
ADDENDUM TO OFFICE SERVICES AGREEMENT
Space Relocation

This Addendum (this "Addendum") is entered into and made effective as of June 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between:

   PROVIDER: KIWI RENTALS LLC, a Delaware limited liability company
             108 West 13th Street, Wilmington, Delaware

   CLIENT:   Naturyl Brows (signed by Jessica Negrete)

RECITALS

A. Provider and Client are parties to that certain Office Services Agreement dated 2026-06-01 (the "Agreement"), pursuant to which Client holds a license (and not a lease) to use Space 404 within Provider's facility located at 6698 68th Ave N, Pinellas Park, FL 33781 (the "Center"). The space currently identified in Schedule A is referred to herein as the "Original Space."

B. Section II.3 of the Agreement reserves to Provider the right to relocate Client to comparable space within the Center upon at least ten (10) days' advance notice. The parties wish to memorialize their mutual agreement to a specific relocation, on the terms set forth below.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. RELOCATION OF SPACE. Effective on the Effective Date, Client shall surrender and vacate the Original Space (Space 404) and shall take possession of Space 446 containing approximately 122 rentable square feet located within the Center (the "New Space"). Schedule A of the Agreement is hereby amended to substitute the New Space for the Original Space. From and after the Effective Date, all references in the Agreement to the "Space" shall mean the New Space.

2. BASE FEE. The monthly Base Fee shall remain unchanged at $750 per month, payable in advance on the first calendar day of each month in accordance with Section IV.1 of the Agreement.

3. SERVICE RETAINER / DEPOSIT. The Service Retainer (Deposit) currently held by Provider under Section IV.3 of the Agreement shall continue to be held by Provider and shall apply to the New Space and to Client's obligations under the Agreement, as modified by this Addendum. No additional Service Retainer shall be required by reason of this relocation.

4. CONDITION OF NEW SPACE. Client accepts the New Space in its then-current "as-is" condition. Provider makes no representation or warranty as to the condition of the New Space except as expressly set forth in the Agreement or in a separate writing signed by Provider. Client's obligations under Section VI.5 (Inventory & Condition) and Section XIV (Vacation; Restoration; Holdover) of the Agreement shall apply to the Original Space upon surrender thereof.

5. NO CHANGE IN CHARACTER OF AGREEMENT. The parties affirm that the Agreement remains a license and not a lease (Section II.1 of the Agreement), and that this relocation does not create a landlord-tenant relationship or any tenancy rights in either the Original Space or the New Space.

6. NO OTHER CHANGES. Except as expressly modified by this Addendum (including the amended Schedule A reference and, where applicable, the actual-day proration override of Section IV.1 for the cutoff month), all terms, covenants, and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect. In the event of any conflict between this Addendum and the Agreement, the terms of this Addendum shall control with respect to the subject matter hereof.

7. COUNTERPARTS; ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES. This Addendum may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Signatures delivered by electronic means (including DocuSign or PDF) shall have the same force and effect as original signatures, consistent with Section XVI.6 of the Agreement.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Addendum as of the Effective Date.
